contract.purpose: Kith helps iPhone users who care about a small set of relationships retain meaningful context through explicitly chosen closeness, standing notes and a dated memory log.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Kith helps a person remember the people they genuinely want to stay close to and act with more thoughtfulness.
contract.driftNote: Canonical Kith purpose agrees with relationship memory. Its owner-validation nextAction and broader attention outcome differ from the current public internal-beta status and explicitly chosen closeness. This local marketing receipt follows repository evidence; the user prohibits production-config edits, so the canonical provider config is untouched.
contract.audience: iPhone users tending a small set of relationships; per-product audience preserved throughout the factory.
contract.job: Understand one native app, inspect authentic evidence and take its honest available next action.
contract.thesis: A living memory book: human moments and physical keepsakes frame exact native app evidence and a clear available action.
contract.system: Ivory paper, coral cloth, indigo semantic ink and rust actions; confident rounded sans; asymmetric desktop spread, action-first phone stack, alternating screenshot chapters. Product tokens and device classes remain independent.
contract.signature: Product-owned bookcloth stage, overlapping illustrative photograph and semantic paper sheet with handwritten margin note.
contract.risk: Art can overpower product comprehension or loading; retain visible action and evidence, optimized art and reduced-motion fallback.
contract.qualityBar: Retain approved C while making photograph, paper, cloth and notebook read as one restrained physical world. Replace stock-like posed faces, inconsistent print scale, loud grain and copy patches. Keep real app unobscured at narrow phone widths, readable notebook copy at intermediate widths and enlargement, natural3-phrase title pacing, stable reduced motion. Owner taste is not inferred from scores or checks.

hierarchy.observation: The product promise, honest status and primary action precede artwork. The smaller print stays subordinate to the actual app.

typography.observation: The notebook title retains its three distinct phrases. Artwork labels remain12px; facts remain readable sans text. Decorative note lettering is unchanged.

composition.observation: The coastal setting connects the print and notebook. Thin landscape framing,4degree rotation, quieter paper and one smaller cup reduce competing scale. Desktop copy now sits wholly on the page, clear of its spine, upper edge and lower cloth.

identity.observation: Selected C coral cloth, ivory paper and indigo writing remain product-owned. Kith actual captures and relationship context lead; generated coastal imagery is disclosed and is not customer proof.

interaction.observation: Root browser verification exercised keyboard skip, FAQ open/close, reduced motion and local beta/legal/support/blog routes. Existing external newsletter and analytics service delivery was intentionally isolated and is unqualified.

responsive.observation: Nine widths320/375/384/390/768/900/1024/1200/1440 clear the app screen. Below390px prints enter normal flow;900–1199px uses a smaller print. Notebook copy stacks through1199px; desktop insets preserve clear paper. Independent100/200percent text diagnostics and reduced motion pass.
